subject: Conservative rebaseline proposal + procurement remediation
messages:
From: Seth Miller <seth.miller@novacare.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation timeline — procurement hold

Rachel / Jordan —

Quick update from our side: procurement pulled the finance sign-off this morning. The SOC2 evidence request and an additional vendor questionnaire triggered an internal budget review that is likely to push our ability to execute contracts past the original June window.

Short version: we are not able to commit to the June 30 close unless we can show procurement the SOC2 artifacts and a compressed evaluation plan that reduces time-to-acceptance. Ella (cc) is triaging the checklist on her end.

Could you send an updated MAP that: 1) shows a conservative close target, 2) lays out a 2-stage evaluation (pilot -> expanded eval), and 3) includes a short-term mitigation (trial credits or extended eval) so procurement has something to take to finance?

I know this is not ideal — happy to hop on a quick call to walk Ella & procurement through the MAP.

Thanks,
Seth
Seth Miller
Director, Platform Integrations
Novacare Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Seth Miller <seth.miller@novacare.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation timeline — Conservative MAP v2 attached

Thanks Seth — I appreciate the heads-up. I put together a conservative rebaseline (attached) and a trimmed evaluation plan for procurement to review. High level:

- New conservative close target: July 31, 2025 (vs prior June 30).
- Two-stage evaluation: 2-week pilot (core API + small production test) -> 4-week expanded eval focused on peak traffic sims and KV cache validation.
- Required procurement artifacts: SOC2 excerpts, change-log of data handling, and a short SLA summary (I attached a one-pager).
- Mitigation offer: 60-day extended evaluation window + up to a one-time credit (TBD) on the first billing cycle to cover the pilot period if procurement approves.

Attachments: Novacare_MAP_v2.xlsx, eval_plan_2025-06.pdf.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ella confirms procurement checklist items (what they need from our SOC2 bundle).
2) We schedule a 30-minute walk-through with procurement + engineering (I can host a demo of the pilot plan).
3) If procurement requires it, I will escalate a small commercial concession to sales ops.

Can Ella confirm the earliest procurement review meeting? Jordan — looping you for scheduling & to flag any legal/contract impacts.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
From: Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com>
To: Seth Miller <seth.miller@novacare.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation timeline — procurement checklist & timing

Rachel / Seth —

Procurement update: our vendor intake shows two outstanding items that prevent us from moving forward this week:
1) We need a SOC2 artifact extract (control narrative + relevant test results). A redacted bundle is fine if you can provide it by EOD Friday, June 13.
2) Finance has a monthly approval cycle; the next enforcement meeting is June 25. If the SOC2 bundle and the pilot acceptance criteria are in place before that meeting, we can keep the July timeline realistic.

If those two items are missing, we will defer the contract to the next cycle (potentially early August).

I can join a short call to review the MAP and the evaluation plan — morning slots on June 12 or June 16 work for me.

Regards,
Ella Rogers
Senior Procurement Manager
Novacare Health
procurement@novacare.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Seth Miller <seth.miller@novacare.com>, Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP / procurement checklist — request for commercial flexibility

Laura / Karthik —

Forwarding procurement's note above. TL;DR: SOC2 bundle + finance cadence push the close out unless we provide evidence quickly. I have attached the conservative MAP v2 and the shortened eval plan.

Ask: can I offer procurement a small, documented concession to preserve the July close? Specifically: a 60-day extended eval + a one-time credit applied to month 1 (covers pilot usage). If you approve the concession I will confirm with Ella and update the MAP with the commercial terms.

Why this matters: Novacare is a strategic opportunity for us in the payer space — losing the momentum into the August cycle creates risk of procurement reprioritization.

Quoted for context:
> On Wed, 11 Jun 2025 at 09:00, Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com> wrote:
> > Procurement update: our vendor intake shows two outstanding items that prevent us from moving forward this week:
> > 1) We need a SOC2 artifact extract (control narrative + relevant test results). A redacted bundle is fine if you can provide it by EOD Friday, June 13.
> > 2) Finance has a monthly approval cycle; the next enforcement meeting is June 25. If the SOC2 bundle and the pilot acceptance criteria are in place before that meeting, we can keep the July timeline realistic.

I need guidance on the max concession we can offer without routing through a lengthy approval process. If the answer is "no concessions," I will flag that and ask procurement for a specific checklist timeline instead.

Thanks,
Rachel
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Seth Miller <seth.miller@novacare.com>, Ella Rogers <ella.rogers@novacare.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP / procurement checklist — approved limited concession

Rachel —

Thanks for the heads-up and the clear ask. Approve the following, on a one-off basis, to protect the deal momentum:

- Commercial concession: one-time credit equal to 10% of the first invoice (applied to month 1).
- Operational concession: 60-day extended evaluation window (pilot -> expanded eval).
- Close target: update MAP to a conservative close of July 31, 2025.

Please update the MAP to reflect these commitments, send the redline to Legal to prep a short amendment, and confirm the SOC2 extract delivery plan by EOD Jun 13 (Rachel). I authorize this without needing a full executive sign-off given the strategic nature of Novacare.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP / procurement checklist — confirmation of new MAP v2 and credit

Rachel / Jordan —

Thanks — Novacare accepts the conservative MAP v2, the 60-day extended evaluation, and the one-time credit. We will deliver the SOC2 extract by end of day Friday (Jun 20) and route this into our June 25 finance meeting.

We will target July 31 as the new close date. Jordan — can you work with our technical lead to schedule a pilot kickoff for the week of June 23? Ella will coordinate the procurement side.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Seth Miller

Novacare Health
